construct: ambient_environmental_quality
reason: Smallest cross-media official 2023 district-quality summary: all27 valid same-definition observations, nonconstant spread, coherent direction and documented common monitoring framework. Admit only this published administrative construct, not its components or population exposure claims.
comparability: One annual DLH panel, same district-level index definition, unit and BPS 2019 administrative identifiers. Permen LHK27/2021 Annex VII district formula: .376 IKA + .405 IKU + .219 IKL. No marine component at district level.
reporting_bias: Not a participation count or missing-to-zero panel. LKIP2023 PDF41 reports passive-sampler monitoring across all27 districts and four location categories; statutory validation and sampling rules apply. Underlying district water/site completeness and exact land-image dates were not independently reacquired. Treat as official administrative summary, not verified equal sensor coverage.
redundancy: Singleton CORE; do not add IKA, IKU, IKL/IKTL or land-cover variants as separate core inputs. IKLH contains no household drinking-water/sanitation access, disease, poverty or IRBI value. Land condition can share conceptual drivers with IRBI environmental vulnerability; no claim of statistical independence.

indicator: Land ecosystem structural bias and DisasterPressure boundary
construct: Construct and redundancy boundary, not a new risk indicator
coverage_or_actual_vintage: Conceptual boundary across all27districts; no new numerical series
reason: Keep ambient degradation separate from hazard/vulnerability/risk and from ecosystem opportunity; do not alter existingDisasterPressure decisions.
comparability: Absolute forest/park area favors larger ruralkabupaten and penalizes densekota even without worse ecological management. A total-area fraction can still reflect coast, mountains, agriculture and legal allocation rather than degradation. Community forest, legal forest designation, actual canopy, plantations, critical land, mangroves, biodiversity parks and public open space are distinct classes. They cannot be added without mutually exclusive mappings. Normalizing by unrelatedBPSarea is insufficient: boundary year, land-versus-water mask, eligible ecosystem opportunity, reference-map scale and classification must match numerator. BNPBIRBI2023methodologyp20 explicitly includes environmental damage inhectares among consequences/vulnerability parameters. This establishes conceptual contact with land ecosystem stocks, not identity with ambient environmental quality. [INFERENCE]More ecologically valuable stock can mean better ecosystem condition but more environmental assets exposed to a given hazard; pressure and vulnerability directions need not match. No empirical duplicate-correlation claim is made because a comparable2023land-state panel and IRBIenvironmental subcomponent were not reconstructed. Do not add hazards, exposedassets, IRBIrisk or disasterlosses toEnvironment. ExistingDisasterPressure classification/weights/values remain unchanged.
